newsitem.title: GEORGIA: More than 20 killed in Georgian bus crash.
newsitem.headline: More than 20 killed in Georgian bus crash.

text.p: At least 23 people were killed and many were injured when a bus plunged over a 60-metre (180-foot) precipice on a mountain road in Georgia and crashed into a river, the interior ministry said on Monday.

The accident happened on Sunday in a remote region 200 km (125 miles) northwest of the capital Tbilisi. The road between Tskhaltubo and Ambrulauri is narrow and potholed, hugging the precipice for much of its route
The ministry could not give a figure for the number injured in the crash. A spokesman said investigators were examining the possibility that the driver might have suffered a heart attack.
